characters.continuity: Star Wars Canon (Films and The Clone Wars)
characters.summary: Padmé Amidala is a resourceful politician, diplomat, and combatant trained in royal security protocols. She primarily fights using standard blaster pistols, tactical positioning, and improvised environmental usage, relying on agility rather than superhuman attributes.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to physical injury and standard blasters due to lacking superhuman durability
limitations: Human physical limits with no Force abilities or technological enhancements

sources.supports: Basic character overview and role in Star Wars.
Combat feats, blaster proficiency, and tactical skills.

feats.claim: Fought off Geonosian beasts and battle droids in the Geonosis arena.

notableResults.citation: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
notableResults.note: Used pole and surrounding chains to escape execution post.

campaignTags.claim: Pilots starfighters and various transport vessels during conflicts.

unknowns: Full extent of her formal Naboo security training details in canon versus Legends.

weaknesses: Requires a specialized anti-toxin mask and protective goggles in oxygen-rich atmospheres
